plans.name: Exposition Park museum day: science, dinos & free admission
plans.summary: Three world-class museums in one walkable park — the California Science Center (free, with the Space Shuttle Endeavour), the Natural History Museum's dinosaur hall, and the California African American Museum. A full rainy-or-shine LA day with no parking shuffle.

plans.name: Griffith Observatory + Kidspace
